mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_itempool (content_id, qlevel, qnum, q, qex, e1, e2, e3, e4, ans, qtype, qexgb, state) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{qlevel}, #{qnum}, #{q}, #{qex}, #{e1}, #{e2}, #{e3}, #{e4}, #{ans}, #{qtype}, #{qexgb}, #{state})

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_itempool (content_id, qlevel, qnum, q, qex, e1, e2, e3, e4, ans, qtype, qexgb, state) VALUES
(#{item.contentId}, #{item.qlevel}, #{item.qnum}, #{item.q}, #{item.qex}, #{item.e1}, #{item.e2}, #{item.e3}, #{item.e4}, #{item.ans}, #{item.qtype}, #{item.qexgb}, #{item.state})

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_itempool_del (log_type, logged_by, content_id, qlevel, qnum, q, qex, e1, e2, e3, e4, ans, qtype, qexgb, state) SELECT #{logType}, #{loggedBy}, content_id, qlevel, qnum, q, qex, e1, e2, e3, e4, ans, qtype, qexgb, state FROM erp_bookstore_itempool WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND qlevel = #{qlevel} AND qnum = #{qnum}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM erp_bookstore_itempool WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND qlevel = #{qlevel} AND qnum = #{qnum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_itempool (content_id, qlevel, qnum, q, qex, e1, e2, e3, e4, ans, qtype, qexgb, state) SELECT d.content_id, d.qlevel, d.qnum, d.q, d.qex, d.e1, d.e2, d.e3, d.e4, d.ans, d.qtype, d.qexgb, d.state FROM erp_bookstore_itempool_del d WHERE d.log_id = #{delId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_itempool p WHERE p.content_id = d.content_id AND p.qlevel = d.qlevel AND p.qnum = d.qnum)
mapper.select:
SELECT i.content_id AS contentId, i.qlevel, i.qnum, c.original_title AS bookTitle FROM erp_bookstore_itempool i JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON i.content_id = c.content_id WHERE 1=0
OR (i.content_id = #{item.contentId} AND i.qlevel = #{item.qlevel} AND i.qnum = #{item.qnum})

SELECT d.log_id AS delId, d.logged_at AS deletedAt, d.logged_by AS deletedBy, d.content_id AS contentId, d.qlevel, d.qnum, d.q, d.qex, d.e1, d.e2, d.e3, d.e4, d.ans, d.qtype, d.qexgb, d.state FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY content_id, qlevel, qnum ORDER BY log_id DESC) AS rn FROM erp_bookstore_itempool_del ) d WHERE d.content_id = #{contentId} AND d.rn = 1 AND d.log_type = 'DELETE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_itempool p WHERE p.content_id = d.content_id AND p.qlevel = d.qlevel AND p.qnum = d.qnum) ORDER BY d.logged_at DESC
